sections.title: Control of Transmission and Use of Electricity by Electrical Inspector
sections.text: Every person proposing to construct or install any electrical plant or electric line or high voltage apparatus or diesel generator (DG) set exceeding prescribed kVA capacity or connected load of 50 kW and above must give notice to the Chief Electrical Inspector to Government (CEIG) and obtain prior safety approval before energization.

sections.title: Approval by Electrical Inspector for High Voltage Installations
sections.text: High Voltage (HT) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) installations, sub-stations, and generating sets shall not be brought into service without the prior inspection and written approval of the Electrical Inspector. Application requires submission of Single Line Diagram (SLD), earthing pit resistance test reports, and electrical contractor completion certificates.
